about_the_game:
SAIL THE TURTLE ISLE

play as The Captain in this simple, short, and fun game. Inspired by some classic top down dungeon crawlers Sword & Sail is a light hearted yet comforting game. from a team of passionate student developers Sword & Sail has plenty to do:

  • ~2 hours of play time 

  • 12 unique Islands

  • dozens of puzzles

  • 4 unique bosses

  • Fun story

  • Upgrades 

  • Open Zone Sailing and on land exploration

we put a lot into actually getting this game launched and we hope that you can find joy in the experience we fought to give you.
